    },
    {
      "name": "operational_delivery_model",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,

    },
    {
      "name": "company_maturity_and_scale",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Ordinal-like, interpretable maturity tiers (early_stage, late_stage, publicly_traded) are a classic external trait to segment by and compare against regional clustering (e.g., startups vs. established firms by region)."
    },
    {
      "name": "primary_customer_segment",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clear B2B/B2C/institutional segmentation offers an interpretable associational axis to compare against region, though the enterprise_b2b class (132) heavily dominates, limiting variation."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 5,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.78,
  "rationale": "All five added columns are genuine external 'company traits' with interpretable, human-readable categories that can each be grouped and cross-tabulated against the regional_cluster focus, directly serving the query about which traits explain regional clustering. None merely restate the focus, and none are opaque scores. The main weakness is class imbalance: several columns are dominated by a single value (saas_cloud_platform 136, enterprise_b2b 132, late_stage_venture 101) and one relies on a large 'other_tech' catch-all, which reduces the discriminating power of the minority categories for cross-regional comparison. Still, the set as a whole provides multiple well-separated, interpretable axes for exploratory relationship discovery."
}
